questions.stem_text: Austin has been described as a 'naive empiricist.' Why?

options.A: Because he neglects the importance of morality.
options.B: Because his account of law is based on an anachronistic model of a legal system.
options.C: Because he conceives of laws in a pragmatic rather than a conceptual manner.
options.D: Because he overlooks the role of law in economic relations.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Because he conceives of laws in a pragmatic rather than a conceptual manner.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following apparent correlatives contradicts Hohfeld's scheme of 'jural
relations'?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Power and liability.

questions.stem_text:
Which statement best describes one of Dworkin's central arguments in Justice for
Hedgehogs?

options.A: Morality plays no role in the concept of law.
options.B: Moral arguments operate only in hard cases.
options.C: The law dictates what moral values should affect our ethical behaviour.
options.D: Moral values are both independent and objective.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Moral values are both independent and objective.

questions.stem_text: What is the function of "standard-setting in human rights diplomacy?

options.A: Standard-setting means putting forward binding legal standards
options.B: Standard-setting means merely proposing binding legal standards
options.C: Standard-setting means putting forward non-binding legal standards
options.D: Standard-setting means setting certain standards of conduct in human rights treaties

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Standard-setting means putting forward non-binding legal standards

questions.stem_text: Is piracy under international (jure gentium) law subject to universal jurisdiction?

options.A: Piracy jure gentium is subject to flag State jurisdiction
options.B: Piracy jure gentium is subject to universal jurisdiction
options.C: Piracy jure gentium is subject to port State jurisdiction
options.D: Piracy jure gentium is subject to nationality-based jurisdiction

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Piracy jure gentium is subject to universal jurisdiction
